en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from a group of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A community cannot be sanctified, the one which does not take for its weak ones, its rights from its strong ones without stirring’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from a group of our people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A people, who does not take back the rights of the weak ones among them from the stronger ones, without causing any harm, can never become holy.’”
